subject.title: fix(security): add default pidsLimit for sandbox containers

question: Should unset Docker sandbox `pidsLimit` become `1024` by default, and what explicit opt-out/config contract must ship with that security default?
rationale: This is a sandbox security hardening change, but it changes existing upgrade behavior and the current schema rejects the documented Docker-default opt-out value.

options.title: Require opt-out alignment before merge
options.body: Keep the 1024 default only after schema, docs, and tests preserve or clearly replace the explicit Docker-default opt-out and real Docker proof is posted.

options.title: Accept the breaking default
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the 1024 cap for unset configs, but should document the upgrade risk and support path before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader resource-limit design
options.body: Close or replace this PR if PID caps should land with a broader owner-backed CPU, memory, and process-limit policy.

recommendation.title: Require opt-out alignment before merge
recommendation.body: Keep the 1024 default only after schema, docs, and tests preserve or clearly replace the explicit Docker-default opt-out and real Docker proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the sandbox security runtime and docs to this review group.
